entries.title: Isaiah 31:1
segments: Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help, and lean on horses and trust in chariots, because [it is] great; and in horsemen, because they are so very strong, but they do not look to the Holy One of Israel, nor do they seek the LORD!

entries.title: Isaiah 31:2
segments: Yet He also [is] wise, and will bring evil, and will not call back His words, but will arise against the house of evil-doers and against the help of those who work iniquity.

entries.title: Isaiah 31:3
segments: And Egypt [is] a man, and not God; and their horses are flesh, and not Spirit. When the LORD shall stretch out His hand, both he who helps shall fall, and he who is helped shall fall down, and they shall all cease together.

entries.title: Isaiah 31:4
segments: For so has the LORD spoken to me: As the lion roars, even the young lion on his prey when a multitude of shepherds are gathered against him, [he] will not be afraid of their voice, nor fret himself because of their noise. So the LORD of hosts shall come down to fight for Mount Zion, and on its hill.

entries.title: Isaiah 31:5
segments: As birds flying, so the LORD of hosts will defend Jerusalem; also defending, He will deliver [it]; and passing over He will preserve [it].

entries.title: Isaiah 31:6
segments: Turn to [Him from] whom the sons of Israel have deeply revolted.

entries.title: Isaiah 31:7
segments: For in that day every man shall cast away his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which your hands have made [for] you, a sin.

entries.title: Isaiah 31:8
segments: Then Assyria shall fall with the sword, not of [great] man; and the sword, not of [lowly] man, shall devour him. For he shall flee from the sword, and his young men shall become forced labor.

entries.title: Isaiah 31:9
segments: And he shall pass over to his stronghold for fear, and his rulers shall be afraid of the banner, says the LORD, whose fire [is] in Zion, and His furnace in Jerusalem.
